envelope.description: Route recovery, publication, cleanup and shutdown through the owner

body.title: Route recovery, publication, cleanup and shutdown through the owner
body.summary: Complete worker-aware resume/recover/publication retry and approval-cleanup paths for both families, including cold worker creation, bounded read-only completed history and shutdown drain order. Preserve existing permanent evidence and execute heavy requalification/publication/cleanup in the target review worker rather than main/session threads.
acceptanceChecks: Explicit recovery retains accepted task/chunk feedback and retry counters and cannot overlap old native work or stale worker ownership.
Publication retry after worker exit or lost receipt consumes saved feedback only, with providerCalls===0; operational guard updates preserve publication identity.
Approval cleanup fences the exact story/artifact across workers, refuses/retains active admission/execution/publication, and deletes only evidence-preserved inactive checkpoints.
Completed reads remain model-free and available after worker exit/cleanup; failed-admission history and clearance receipts survive permanent publication.
Normal daemon shutdown aborts/drains host native leases before worker termination/reclamation; unknown disposal remains targeted and explicit.

Bind actual story/artifact approval-cleanup callers to the main registry's exclusion API, including unknown admission scope and active publication; worker-local coordinator maps cannot authorize cross-worker cleanup.

tests.name: src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-worker-publication.test.ts: publication retry after worker exit or lost receipt performs zero provider calls
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-worker-cleanup.test.ts: approval cleanup retains active targets and preserves both-family permanent history
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-worker-recovery.test.ts: shutdown drains host leases before worker reclamation and replacement
